sentences.text: Ask 3 Linda has now invited a traveller to try some of the items available from the restaurants and coffee shops at the airport.
Put a take if the traveller likes the food, a cross if he doesn’t, or a question mark if he’s not sure.
The items may not be mentioned in the same order as they appear in the question answer Book.
One space has been filled in for you as an example.
You now have 30 seconds to study the task.
At the end of the task, you will have one minute to tidy up your answers So
we're from the Airport Authority and were wondering if you'd like to try some of the food and drink items available at our various restaurant outlets Sure.
I was just thinking how hungry I was.
Okay, Let's start with the hot dog then.
Take a bite of that.
It’s from Hot Dog Express.
Well, I'm not a big hot dog fan, but I'll it a go.
No, I can’t say this one persuades me either.
No, that’s not for me.
It’s too salty Oh, Make a note of that, Chris.
Too salty. All right, perhaps you should choose something you like the look of.
Well, that tortilla looks pretty good.
I love Mexican food usually.
That's really good, and it’s got loads in it What's so special about it?
Well, it’s spicy, really hot, and I don’t mean heat hot.

And the other thing is, it’s really filling, you know, tortillas fill you up, not like some other snacks which just leave you feeling hungry Okay, that’s from Viva Tortilla, which has only recently opened.
Now What about these chicken skewers from the food court, how do you feel about those?
Let me just take one there.
Hm, my sauce, that’s tasty, yeah, finger looking good, as they say.
Just write down tasty sauce Chris.
chicken’s a bit stringy though.
Oh, very stringy!
and I could floss my teeth with that Oh, What a horrible idea!
Stringy is just G -Y, Chris, not G -E -Y.
Oh, and I guess you should put a question mark in the second column.
I'll have a word with the manager of the to wash that down with a sip of our tropical smoothie from the Waikiki Bar.
Mmm, Lovely! That hit the spot.
It’s very cool, I see cool in fact, and refreshing.
Yeah, that really makes you feel refreshed.
Oh, you've missed out on the sushi Actually, I was trying to avoid that.
Japanese isn’t my favourite cuisine.
I'll have a go, Oh,
sorry, do you have a napkin?
Oh, That's not for me.
It’s much too fishy.
Well, it is raw fish.
Yes, I know, but there’s fish, which I usually like especially with chips then there’s, well, fishy, which I don’t.
How about a mouthful of cupcake to take the taste away?
way. I won't say no.
Well? Hmm. Gosh, I'm in it.
Mouthful. Well, I can’t decide really.
It’s light, not at all heavy, which is a good thing, but otherwise a bit tasteless.
Yeah, tasteless is the word I'd use.
Make a note of both of those, Chris.
I can’t make up my mind if I like it or not.
Well, thanks ever so much for helping us with the survey.
Now, if you’d like to put your business card into our lucky drawer hats.
